preconditions: Original package-local routing-only #[path] module names shared oracle runtime and nested architecture. Separate ordinary lib and test=true compilations; compare exact source-selected owners in each. Selected functions are unsuppressed and outside default target/** exclusion. Missing/ambiguous/generated owners remain unavailable.

denominator.sampling: Four source-positive spacing cases plus three representative clean functions in both check/test contexts. No exhaustive project recall claim.

parameter_plan_quality.basis: All 18 original source function signatures contain at most two parameters; production limit is4. Existing stacking planner requires fn_params violators. Recovered edges must not invent a signature change, parameter bundle or pass-through recommendation.
parameter_plan_quality.negative_control: runtime::architecture::caller_arch forwards both parameters unchanged to batch_arch, but neither violates the production parameter limit. This is no positive planner-quality gain.

limitations: Selected original-source spacing/parameter/mutated-target quality only, not density-quality, effect absence, global recall, full-project coverage, migration completion or refactoring safety. Three local fills in surrounding_bytes meet but do not exceed default per-target limit3; source loop desugaring cannot manufacture budget findings. Panic assertions or callback effects are outside this quality comparison. Original executable oracle sources remain unchanged. Manual code-line counts are supporting metadata only; every selected function is below production max_lines50, and no length comparison is requested.
